The **Combat Knife** is a melee weapon in *Fallout 76*.

A standard-issue military fighting knife, the combat knife features a clip-point blade with a shallow fuller and a rubber grip with a small handguard and pommel.

The stealth blade modification darkens the blade while accentuating the fuller and adding serrations to the blade. Sneak attacks will do more damage and attacking with the stealth blade combat knife will inflict additional bleeding damage on a target.
